FROM:

DATE: June 30，2014
SUBJECT:
Consideration of Bid#R-3-15 for the sale of surplus
property described as Lots 1 & 2， Block 15, Roberts
Place，an addition to the City of Cheyenne，Laramie
County, Wyoming (generally located_at the southwest
corner of O'Neil Avenue and West 5th Street).
On April 14， 2014, the governing body declared the above
referenced property surplusand authorized the advertisement of bid
for its Sale (reference: Resolution No.5581).
Three bids were received, the recommendation is to accept bid
from Holy Temple Church of God in Christ for a total bid amount of
$27,1o0.00.The successful bidder is required to reimbursed the
City of Cheyenne for the cost of the appraisal, which was $400.00.
The appraisal market value of the property was $27,000.00. The
bidder hasbeen notified of the Finance Committee and City Council
dates and times.
The City will be responsible for preparation of a Quit Claim
Deed for the property.
